senses: tremble, quake, rage, quiver, be agitated, be excited, be perturbed
(Qal) to quake, be disquieted, be excited, be perturbed
(Hiphil) to cause to quake, disquiet, enrage, disturb

strongs.def: to quiver (with any violent emotion, especially anger or fear)
strongs.kjv: be afraid, stand in awe, disquiet, fall out, fret, move, provoke, quake, rage, shake, tremble, trouble, be wroth
